info.title: ReNR+ organization access
info.description: Additive ID03 contract. Legacy sessions keep ADMIN/READER and their existing DTO. TECHNICAL_DECISIONS is explicit authorization, not professional qualification. EXECUTE_ASSIGNED_ACTIONS requires server-loaded persistent assignment from ID13; it grants no global write. Tokens appear once in create/reissue bodies and are never placed in URLs, lists or logs.
